## Cálculo de $P(B_i \mid A)$
<div class="twocol">

<div class="card fragment fade-up" data-fragment-index="1">
<ul>

<li class="fragment fade-up text-justify no-bullets" data-fragment-index="2" style="font-size: 26px;">
$$P(B_1 \mid A) = \frac{0.40}{0.73} \approx 0.5479$$
</li>
<li class="fragment fade-up text-justify no-bullets" data-fragment-index="3" style="font-size: 26px;">
$$P(B_2 \mid A) = \frac{0.21}{0.73} \approx 0.2877$$
</li>
<li class="fragment fade-up text-justify no-bullets" data-fragment-index="4" style="font-size: 26px;">
$$P(B_3 \mid A) = \frac{0.12}{0.73} \approx 0.1644$$
</li>
<li class="fragment fade-up" data-fragment-index="5" style="font-size: 26px; text-align: justify; color: #059669;list-style-type: none; margin-top: 15px;">
<strong>Verificación:</strong> $0.5479 + 0.2877 + 0.1644 = 1.00$
</li>
</ul>
